name: gradient
title: color.gradient
lead: The colour `u` (0 to 1) of the way along the list; with `loop`, `u` wraps and the last colour runs back into the first.
signature: color.gradient(list: { Ink }, u: number, loop: boolean ?) → Color

usedIn.quote: color.gradient({ "gold", colors.white, "#3366ff" }, u)   -- the colour u (0..1) of the way along the list
color.gradient(list, u, true)                           -- a loop: u wraps, and the last colour runs back into the first
function(_, i, n, t) return { color = color.gradient(list, (i - 1) / n - t * speed, true) } end
